play.auctionRulesDescription: Get a $350M budget, bid on mystery footballers from 5 stat clues, and build the most profitable 7-player squad — chemistry multiplies your profit.
play.auctionRule1: Everyone starts with a $350M budget and builds a 7-player squad: a goalkeeper, 2 defenders, 2 midfielders and 2 forwards.
play.auctionRule2: Each round a mystery footballer comes up for sale: one real season of his career is revealed stat by stat, plus two career hints.
play.auctionRule3: The starting price is a real market value from a season in his career.
play.auctionRule4: Bid or pass — you are never forced to buy. If everyone passes, the card is discarded and a new one appears.
play.auctionRule5: His value TODAY stays hidden until the hammer falls. Your profit is that hidden value minus what you paid — overpay and the loss counts against your score.
play.auctionRule6: Chemistry links between your players (same club, league or nation) multiply your profit — about +10% per chemistry point.
play.auctionRule7: When every squad is full, the highest score wins: profit × chemistry bonus (chemistry amplifies gains, never losses).

announcements.rpRebalanceBody:
Friends, after the World Cup event started we discovered a minor bug in the Ranked points system. Specifically, during Placement matches (first 3 matches) players were receiving more points than intended.

The bug has been fully fixed and the Ranked points system now works as originally designed.

Because of this, some players' ratings and Ranked points have been automatically corrected based on their win/loss history to keep the leaderboard fair and accurate for all participants.

We apologize for any inconvenience. 🙏

The updated Ranked points system and rules can be found in the Rules section on the leaderboard page.

Good luck in the World Cup event! 🏆⚽
